    lst.iter()
        .enumerate()
        .filter(|(i, _)| i % 2 == 0)
        .filter(|(_, &x)| x % 2 != 0)
        .map(|(_, &x)| x)
        .sum()
}

code:
fn double_the_difference(lst: Vec<f64>) -> isize {
    lst.iter()
        .filter(|&&x| x > 0.0 && x.fract() == 0.0)
        .filter(|&&x| (x as isize) % 2 != 0)
        .map(|&x| (x as isize) * (x as isize))
        .sum()
}
